applies_why: The judge text treats Matthew 1:20 as answered and does not count it as an unanswered witness toward a broken link.
quote: Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: Because the judge text says the verse was answered rather than counting it as an unanswered witness, it does not breach K-G4.
